description: Repairs r-expr-1b/cmp-stored-lanes: a type mismatch at open hid the per-row outcomes. Asks the same nine selections over Mx (T = N, N = T, T < 10, T = D, N = Y, DT = N, T Is Null OR T = '', NOT (N > 0), N > 0 OR T = 'abc') one row at a time: SELECT ID FROM Mx WHERE ID = k AND (predicate) for k = 1 to 5, each in its own snapshot. Fixture r-fix-expr-sql-expr is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field. Each statement is preceded by a marker (a DROP TABLE of a table that does not exist, which always fails), so DBEngine.Errors read after the statement shows that statement's own failure or the marker's, never an older one. Where Field Precision and Scale are read, the recordset is first positioned on its first row (MoveFirst) and DecimalPlaces is not read.
